text: Framer natively integrates with external AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) giving them direct access to a project
quote: Framer works directly with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other AI tools. Native access to Framer with your own AI agents

text: Plugins are small apps that can interact with the editor and canvas, e.g. inserting images, layers, or code components
quote: Plugins in Framer are small apps that can interact with the editor. They enable you to perform various actions such as inserting images, layers and code components

text: Custom React 'Code Components' can be built with visual controls to render anything on a site
quote: Code Components Custom React Components with visual controls to render anything on your site.

text: Fetch lets designers build API-backed endpoints and use them on Framer sites without writing code
quote: Fetch Building API endpoints that designers can use on their Framer sites without code.

text: A Server API lets you connect Framer into your own product and automate publishing
quote: Server API Connect your product and automate publishing with the Framer API.

text: Built-in AI agent generates editable pages, sections, copy, and visuals directly inside a project
quote: Framer’s AI agent creates editable pages, sections, copy, and visuals directly in your project.

text: Describing a desired look lets the AI agent automatically set colors, fonts, component styles, motion and effects site-wide
quote: Describe the look you want. The agent takes care of colors, fonts, component styles, motion and effects across your site.

text: A CMS agent sets up, organizes and updates the entire CMS, keeping content and canvas design in sync
quote: The CMS agent sets up, organizes, and updates your entire CMS, connecting it directly to the canvas so content and design stay in sync.

text: Agent can bulk-import CSV data into linked CMS collections and auto-link records (e.g. articles to categories)
quote: Added two linked collections: 1. Articles — 39 CSV rows imported. 2. Categories — 10 rows added and linked to Articles as multi-select tags.

text: Staging environments let you test site changes on a framer.app domain before pushing live
quote: Staging environments. Test changes securely on a framer.app domain before pushing live.

text: Branching lets you explore changes in isolation and merge back into the main project when ready
quote: Branching. Explore ideas in a branch without touching the main project. Merge when it’s ready to ship.

text: Every site change is auto-saved with full version history so any earlier version can be restored in seconds
quote: Version history and rollback. Every site change is saved automatically, so you can restore any version in seconds.

text: Password protection controls who can access a shared site for clients, partners, or team members
quote: Password protection. Control who gets access when sharing with clients, partners, or your team.

text: Supports migrating an existing site from another website builder into Framer
quote: Switch to Framer](https://www.framer.com/switch/?md): Migration from another builder.

text: On-page editing lets you update content directly on the live site and publish instantly
quote: On-page editing. Update content directly on your live site and publish instantly.

text: Once connected, an external agent can read and write CMS collections — creating, updating, and deleting items
quote: Once connected, the agent can read and write CMS collections, including creating, updating, and deleting items.

text: Agent can restyle an entire site's typography (e.g. swap heading/body fonts) from a natural-language instruction
quote: Update the entire site’s typography. Use Fraunces for headings and Inter for body text.

text: Agent can reorganize a page's layout, e.g. converting a list section into a grid of cards
quote: Reorganize the features section from a list layout to a 2x3 grid of feature cards.

text: Framer explicitly forgoes a separate MCP server, instead giving agents native direct access to canvas, components, CMS and project context
quote: Framer doesn’t require a separate MCP server. If you’re searching for a Framer MCP, the native Framer External Agent connection gives Claude Code, Cursor, Codex... direct access to your canvas, components, CMS, and project context, without

text: Code Overrides are Higher Order Components that let developers modify layer and component properties via code
quote: Code Overrides Higher Order Components to modify Layer and Component properties.

text: Agent can restyle a site with a new brand color palette applied globally from a natural-language spec
quote: Update the entire site to use our new brand colors: primary #1A1A2E, accent #E94560, and light background #F5F5F5.

text: Agent can switch an entire site between light and dark mode, updating backgrounds, text, and component colors
quote: Switch the site from light mode to dark mode with dark backgrounds, light text, and updated component colors throughout.

text: Agent can restructure a homepage's content flow based on conversion best practices (reordering sections, CTAs)
quote: Reorganize the homepage flow based on conversion best practices. Move social proof higher, put pricing before the FAQ, and make sure every section leads naturally into the next with a clear CTA.

text: External agent changes are automatically isolated on a branch, allowing undo, review, and controlled merge back to main
quote: Framer has branching, so every change made by an external agent automatically happens on a branch. You can undo changes, review the branch, and decide when to merge it back into your main branch.

text: You remain in control of what an agent's CMS edits actually get published
quote: Yes. Once connected, the agent can read and write CMS collections, including creating, updating, and deleting items. You stay in control of what gets published.
